'''''Valiant''''' was the transport of the [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Harko Vane]]. In it, he tried to breach the Republic blockade of his planet, but the ship was set to explode by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who made it to look destroyed by Republic forces in order to pull the Valahari into war.
